source_note: Norfolk Southern Corporation (NSC, CIK 702165) standalone historicals for the UNP pending-merger block. Sources: SEC EDGAR filings only (8-K Ex. 99.1 earnings releases and Ex. 99.2 financial tables, 10-Q and 10-K primary documents) as listed per period. USD millions as published; shares in millions; per-share in dollars; percentages as numbers. Costs positive (credits, e.g. Eastern Ohio net recoveries or line-sale gains in Materials and other, are negative as published). Quarters are discrete three-month figures; Q1-24..Q3-24 come from 10-Qs because NSC's own 2024 Q1-Q3 releases are not in the source set (cross-checked to the comparative columns of the 2025 releases). Fields marked DERIVED in notes are FY minus 9M. short_term_investments is null throughout: NSC's balance sheet has no short-term investments line (only non-current 'Investments'). total_debt = current maturities + long-term debt. operating_lease_liabilities_total only printed in 10-Ks (null for quarters other than Q4). shares_outstanding_m: 10-Q cover / balance-sheet parenthetical at period end.

ngaap.definition_note: Items list = the itemised non-GAAP reconciliation columns (exact column headers) from the 10-Q/10-K MD&A, as [label, pre-tax $m added back to GAAP income from railway operations (or to pre-tax income for nonop items), after-tax $m added back to GAAP net income, where]. Positive = adds to adjusted income. release_items = the exact rows of the earnings release's own non-GAAP table [label, effect on income from railway operations $m, effect on diluted EPS $]. 2023 10-K 'Non-GAAP Reconciliation for 2023' (repeated in 2024 and 2025 10-Ks): adjusted results exclude the effects of the Incident. Adjusted income taxes 763 (GAAP 493 + 270).

2023.notes: IS/BS/volume from 2023 10-K (identical in 2024 10-K comparatives). Property additions: 2,327 per the 2024 10-K cash-flow statement, which shows 'Acquisition of assets of CSR' (22) separately; the 2023 10-K's own cash-flow statement printed Property additions (2,349) including that $22m. Operating ratio 76.5 from the 10-K non-GAAP table. Dividends $5.40/share from the stockholders' equity statement. Operating lease liabilities = 'Total lease liabilities' (current 105 + non-current 287). total_debt = current maturities + long-term debt (sum of printed lines). No Q4-23 release in source set, so no 2023 quarterly data.
